hook: A 27B model shrunk to 7.2 gigabytes, no math lost.

beats.say: LookAtMyQuant is a quantization compiler that measures how much each part of a model hurts output when compressed, then spends bits where they matter.
It takes Qwen3.8-27B from 53.7 gigabytes to 7.2, and still solves 401 of 540 math problems, as many as the original.
Inkling 2 Mini gets six Apple Silicon builds, from 3.85 to 12.76 gigabytes, reaching down to 8 gigabyte iPhones.
